name: audit-a-scientific-claim
description: Review a conclusion someone will act on against evidence independent of its author.
---

# Audit a scientific claim

1. State the decision this deliverable supports. In the language of the assignment, name its unit, intended population and the evidence required to make it.
2. Derive what you should expect from the original request and governing sources. Work outward from the original records to determine what actually happened. Two summaries produced by the same procedure can share a mistake.
3. Check a case that could change the decision. If the evidence disagrees, locate the first discrepancy and see whether you can resolve it with the supplied authority, data and tools.
4. Deliver the result the evidence supports. Preserve valid work, correct or narrow unsupported claims, and identify any material gap that remains. Check the saved artifact and its conclusions together.

## Exercise

Review the [paired-subject analysis](../../benchmarks/tasks/subjects/). Identify who contributes to the reported comparison and independently reconstruct one participant's contribution.

name: test-the-deployment-claim
description: Verify whether a model comparison measures performance on the intended deployment population.
---

# Test the deployment claim

1. Describe the prediction event. Who or what should be new, what can legitimately have been seen, and what information exists at prediction time?
2. Inspect actual membership and feature provenance for fitting, selection and evaluation. Compare identities, related observations, and time boundaries as the use case requires. Check an example on either side of the boundary.
3. Reconstruct the candidate and baseline on a common admissible evaluation. Keep the metric and eligible inputs comparable. Verify the fitted artifact can produce the predictions being claimed.
4. Preserve gains that survive this test. Repair the comparison or narrow its conclusion when the evidence covers a different deployment setting. Confirm the released artifact reflects that choice.

## Exercise

Review the [prediction task](../../benchmarks/tasks/prediction/). State what the validation population establishes about the proposed use.
